title: Encrypted authenticated secure-frame contract
summary: After handshake, PROBE, DELIVER, HEALTH and RESULT bodies are wrapped in queue.transport/2 SECURE frames. ChaCha20 encrypts the plaintext and a separate HMAC-SHA-512 authenticates protocol, direction, transcript and ciphertext; the MAC is checked before decryption.
invariants: Authentication failure must stop processing before decryption or application dispatch.
Direction is authenticated as part of the secure-frame contract.
HELLO and CHALLENGE metadata remain authenticated but visible; application command/result bodies are confidential after challenge.

provenance.claim: seal/open implement ChaCha20 plus HMAC-SHA-512 and verify MAC before decrypt.
Security properties and explicit visibility of handshake metadata.
Validation records encrypted PROBE/DELIVER/HEALTH/RESULT with authentication before decryption/application processing.
